messages.subject: Project Drake — draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Mark,

Draft Heads of Terms attached for your review ahead of sending to the sellers' side. Key commercial points: EV £42.5m cash-free/debt-free; £39.5m initial cash with a £3m escrow; up to £3m earn-out on FY26 EBITDA; target working capital £4.2m; 10-week exclusivity. Exclusivity, costs, confidentiality and governing law are the only binding parts.

James
